title: The Sons of Israel in Egypt and the Introduction of Slavery
description: After Joseph and his generation had died, the people of Israel grew so numerous that a new king in Egypt feared them. He imposed harsh slave labor and tried to limit their population by ordering the killing of newborn boys, but the midwives Shiphrah and Puah feared God and let the boys live. Finally, Pharaoh commanded that all newborn Hebrew boys be thrown into the Nile.
